{{Youmay|the [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]]|the [[Amara (Human)|senator]] or the [[Amara Jedselk|Imperial officer]]}}
'''Amara''' was an [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] who maintained a [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] shadowfeed during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. A confident [[Computer/Legends|computer]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]], Amara operated the feed in secrecy, allowing the discussion of topics that were otherwise deemed forbidden by [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. On one occasion, Amara offered to provide a curious client with such secrets free of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|charge]]. The broker did so without knowing the credibility of the information, hoping that the client would pursue and verify it themselves.
